name: tube-amp-cad
description: Browser schematic editor and circuit simulator for vacuum-tube amplifiers, with a curve tracer, oscilloscope and spectrum analyzer.
author: Andrey Dumchin (https://aerocat.tech)

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:engine && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:reference
scripts.test:engine: node --test tests/engine.test.mjs tests/bias.test.mjs tests/scope.test.mjs tests/board.test.mjs tests/spice.test.mjs tests/ui-kit.test.mjs tests/tolerance.test.mjs tests/pool.test.mjs tests/opamp.test.mjs tests/regulator.test.mjs tests/diode.test.mjs tests/protection.test.mjs tests/smd.test.mjs tests/sources.test.mjs tests/gas.test.mjs tests/switching.test.mjs tests/indicators.test.mjs tests/place.test.mjs
scripts.test:dist: node tests/e2e.mjs dist/tube-amp-cad && node tests/reference.mjs dist/tube-amp-cad
